description: SMOKE TEST ONLY: tiny subset of configs/protocol.json (full panel incl. extras) to validate the pipeline end to end. Never use for results.

seeds.note: split s uses root seed base + stride*s; independent child streams (data, split, init, model, strategy) are derived with numpy SeedSequence.

uncertain_band.note: margin m(x) = p(1)(x) - p(2)(x). Band U_tau = {x in pool : m(x) < tau}; width = |U_tau|/|pool|. Logged at every round. Effective dimension and clusterability of the lowest-margin 20% are logged at geometry_rounds only (costly).

synthetic.source: sklearn.datasets.make_classification, regenerated per split with the split data seed

letter_recognition.note: 26 classes: the stratified initial set needs >= 1 point per class; 40 keeps the 20-step grid (40..400).

tabular.source: OpenML-derived .txt files (tab-separated, label = last column), archived on Zenodo

latent.source: ResNet-18 penultimate-layer features + PCA, archived on Zenodo (encoder: see data card)

panel.note: 'main' is the 17-strategy panel of the paper. 'extras' holds the router (standalone V58, the only version shipped) and WALC as a fixed mode, so that the router can be compared fairly to all three modes it routes over. Extras are run by default so that the decision to report the router can be taken at analysis time without re-running. 'dualselect' runs the released DualSelect package (KBS 2026) through an adapter (src/alframework/bench/external.py): shared initial set, masked pool labels, exact batch size; hyper-parameters are those of the DualSelect paper (benchmarks/config.py of the dualselect repository). 'dbal_dualselect' is the DBAL implementation released with DualSelect (least-confidence uncertainty, unweighted k-means), run to reconcile the rankings of the two papers.
